scope: Complete systemd helper and root-discovery bodies; selected StepExec capture, admission resolution and spawning bodies. Not full transitive closure.

corrections.correct: maxChars = 8 * 1024 * 1024 string characters, followed by a truncation notice when overflow is observed. This is not a byte limit.
corrections.basis: boundedChunkReducer uses effect/String length and slice after decoding streams.

findings.bunResolution: Without a pin, probes HOME-relative mise shim then standalone Bun using stat (including symlink target and executable mode bits); falls back to process.execPath. A pin is expanded and resolved, not executable-validated by this helper.
findings.pathResolution: Leading ~/ expands using supplied home; relative paths use the supplied platform resolver and its current working directory.
findings.installedUnits: Reads existence and text under HOME/.config/systemd/user. Parsing preserves ordered Key=Value lines without section tracking; lookup returns the first matching directive. No live systemd introspection occurs in these helpers.
findings.unitInputValidation: SystemdUnitPath rejects quotes, backslashes, percent/dollar signs and control characters. This constraint alone does not pin filesystem identity or executable bytes.
findings.rootDiscovery: Starts from explicit startFrom or process.cwd(); walks parents and accepts existence of .git or bun.lock. Presence errors are treated as absent. Uses existence, not marker-content hashing.
findings.capture: Refs merge capture separately decodes stdout and stderr, then merges streams; interleaving is not a deterministic combined-log contract. stdout mode ignores stderr. trim and truncation change the returned text. No redaction is established by these reviewed routines.
findings.admission: runCaptured resolves explicit, fiber-local and inherited admission metadata before spawning. The reviewed path reads BEEP_YEET_ADMISSION_WORKLOAD_PATH and BEEP_YEET_ADMISSION_LEASE_ID even when the caller disables ordinary child environment inheritance. Child registration and deadline cleanup are additional effects; full implementations remain outside this bounded review.
